The theme feature (praisonaiui.features.theme) holds the dashboard's colour preset, mode (dark or light) and corner radius on the server, and serves them as CSS custom properties (--db-*) over /api/theme. The vanilla dashboard style and its chat page read these variables; the React app shell bridges them to its own tokens.
PUT /api/theme accepts any of preset (one of the 22 presets or a registered custom theme; an unknown name returns 400), mode and radius, and returns the full state.

Each mode sets a group of --db-* variables; the preset adds the accent and the radius setting adds --db-radius. A few of them: Variable Dark Light Usage --db-bg #18181b #fafafa Page background --db-text #ffffff #18181b Primary text --db-text-dim #a1a1aa #71717a Secondary text --db-border #3f3f46 rgba(0,0,0,0.08) Borders --db-card-bg rgba(255,255,255,0.03) rgba(0,0,0,0.02) Cards --db-hover #27272a rgba(0,0,0,0.04) Hover background --db-accent preset accent preset accent Buttons, links, highlights --db-accent-rgb preset r,g,b preset r,g,b Accent with alpha --db-accent-glow accent at 15% accent at 15% Focus and glow Sidebar, muted, popover, semantic (--db-success, --db-warning, --db-error, --db-info) and scrollbar variables follow the same pattern. Override any of them with aiui.set_custom_css().

A custom theme is an accent colour. Register one from Python: accent is any CSS colour; accentRgb is derived from a hex accent and is required otherwise. An invalid value raises ValueError. The theme then appears in the theme picker and in /api/theme/presets. Or over HTTP: A built-in preset name cannot be registered or deleted.

Endpoint Method Description /api/theme GET Full theme state and CSS variables /api/theme PUT Set preset, mode and/or radius /api/theme/presets GET All presets with accents, split into builtin and custom /api/theme/register POST Register a custom theme (name, accent, optional accentRgb) /api/theme/{name} DELETE Delete a custom theme
